import copy, collections, json
from yt_dlp.utils._utils import url_or_none

SUBS_INPUT = [
    {"url": "http://ex.com/a.vtt", "ext": "vtt", "id": "en", "quality": 5},
    {"url": "http://ex.com/b.vtt", "ext": "vtt", "id": "en", "quality": 0},
    {"url": "http://ex.com/c.vtt", "ext": "vtt", "id": "en"},
    {"url": "invalid", "data": "<srt>...", "id": "es", "quality": 7},
    {"data": "<vtt>...", "ext": 42, "quality": 2},
    {"url": "https://ex.com/sub.srt", "id": "fr", "ext": "srt", "quality": -3},
]

subs = copy.deepcopy(SUBS_INPUT)
lang='und'; ext='vtt'
result = collections.defaultdict(list)
for sub in subs:
    if not url_or_none(sub.get('url')) and not sub.get('data'):
        continue
    sub_id = sub.pop('id', None)
    if not isinstance(sub_id, str):
        if not lang:
            continue
        sub_id = lang
    sub_ext = sub.get('ext')
    if not isinstance(sub_ext, str):
        if not ext:
            sub.pop('ext', None)
        else:
            sub['ext'] = ext
    result[sub_id].append(sub)
result = dict(result)

it = iter(result.values())
first = next(it)
first.sort(key=lambda x: x.pop('quality', 0) or 0)

print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=True))
PY
